invariant.portable_principle: Three or more direct source siblings sharing a declared first domain token are a navigational cluster worth human triage.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Preserve the Python ADR 0006 promotion, test-prefix, sparse-package, and pages-route-mirror bands.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: Only declared --typescript-root directories are walked; direct .ts/.tsx siblings group on their first _ or - token.

reference_repairs.issue: The selected Python skill imported repository-level _common scope and report helpers, so a copied selected skill failed under python -I -S.
reference_repairs.repair: Bundled minimal family-local scope traversal and report rendering in scripts/support.py without changing Python detection bands.

reference_repairs.issue: An out-of-project --root silently widened to a whole-project scan despite the documented invalid-target behavior.
reference_repairs.repair: Both root forms now fail clearly with exit 2 when invalid or outside --project-root.

syntax: Filename extension and first _ or - delimiter only
runtime: Runs under python -I -S from a copied selected-skill directory
